run: PR #1165 mobile roadmap recovery, linked-issue integration, and final verification

issues.description: The first final sandbox smoke could not exercise product behavior because the command-cell host reaped the background sandbox after the launcher returned. The run was recorded as failed, rerun with the launcher shell held in the foreground, and passed without a product change; non-blocking issue #1186 tracks an automation-stable foreground mode.
issues.detected_by: failure triage plus the required failed/pass smoke postmortems

issues.description: The first #1175 release contract required committed evidence to contain the SHA of the commit containing that evidence, an unsatisfiable self-reference. It was corrected to pin an immutable tested source and allow evidence-only descendants. A later positional acceptance-status edit temporarily marked human gates passed, but an explicit criterion-by-ID audit caught and corrected it before commit or push.
issues.detected_by: release-contract execution and semantic criterion-status audit before the evidence commit

notes: Every repair-loop failure was classified, corrected, revalidated from the appropriate gate, and durably recorded. No global skill edit is proposed: the evidence-provenance rule is now executable in the repo contract, while the sandbox lifecycle gap is a repo tooling enhancement tracked by #1186.
